metrics.name: Active Customers
metrics.business_definition: Distinct customers whose customer_status is Active.
metrics.expression: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN customer_status = 'Active' THEN customer_id END)

metrics.name: Average Transaction Value
metrics.business_definition: Average amount per transaction in the selected scope.

metrics.name: Failed Transaction Count
metrics.business_definition: Count of transaction attempts with status Failed.
metrics.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

metrics.name: Failed Transaction Rate
metrics.business_definition: Failed transaction attempts divided by total transaction attempts (aligned with Retail Banking Knowledge policy).
metrics.expression: AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'Failed' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)

metrics.name: Successful Transaction Count
metrics.business_definition: Count of transaction attempts with status Success.
metrics.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

metrics.name: Total Transaction Amount
metrics.business_definition: Total monetary value of transactions in the selected scope.

metrics.name: Transaction Count
metrics.business_definition: Number of transaction attempts in the selected scope.
